==Fight a Slug ship==
Note: The enemy ship will have at least one Fire Beam or Fire Bomb.
*{{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and your systems return to normal. You collect what you can.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, their hacking system shuts down and your systems return to normal. You strip the ship.}}
**You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "NEBULA_SLUG_OXYGEN" in the datafiles.
* The enemy ship doesn't surrender, nor tries to escape.
* This is the only event which contains a blue option for (upgraded) Oxygen system.
* Upgraded Oxygen system can be similarly used in the [[Dangerous-looking ship]] event.
